decisions.decision: Use Segment for event tracking instead of RudderStack.

reasoning.claim: Better debuggability is prioritized over the small cost difference.

source.speaker: Nina Patel
source.quote: Reversing the earlier decision. Final decision: use Segment for event tracking instead of RudderStack. Debuggability matters more than the small cost difference. Marco still owns setup, and we need it ready before lifecycle launch on 2026-09-25.

reasoning.claim: The real cost difference is much smaller.

source.speaker: Marco Silva
source.quote: Update: I checked the implementation details. RudderStack's cheaper plan does not include the replay tooling support needs, so the real cost difference is much smaller.

reasoning.claim: Segment has cleaner integrations with the lifecycle tools.

source.speaker: Marco Silva
source.quote: RudderStack is cheaper for our current volume, but Segment has cleaner integrations with the lifecycle tools. If cost is the main factor, I would pick RudderStack.

objections.claim: RudderStack had trouble debugging missing events during the March onboarding campaign.

source.speaker: Aisha Rahman
source.quote: I'm concerned about using RudderStack because the support team had trouble debugging missing events during the March onboarding campaign. Assuming cost matters more than support workflow, RudderStack is fine.
